channel.title: Counter & Crisp — buying guides
channel.description: Question-shaped buying guides for countertop cooking gear: air fryers and thermometers, compared with sources attached.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Two shapes, two philosophies of countertop cooking. The comparison that actually decides it is not capacity — it is what you cook most.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Quarts on a box are not quarts on a counter. A plain checklist for judging how much actually fits — and how much you need.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The two costs of an appliance that never leaves the counter. How to weigh them before the box arrives.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Ten functions on the box usually means three you'll use. The questions that reveal which ones.

item.title: Instant-read or smart wireless: which meat thermometer setup fits your kitchen?
item.description: One asks a question and answers in a second; the other watches the whole cook. How to choose — with USDA's numbers.
